title: Cheat module names
note: Feature names used by the structural cheat-module heuristic (SSME-H-MODULE_CLASSES). They never report on their own: an archive needs 3+ distinct feature classes, or 2+ high-signal ones. Names with scope 'memory' are also searched in the game's memory (4+ distinct names needed). Add names here to extend the heuristic.

defaults.falsePositives: Individually not evidence; see SSME-H-MODULE_CLASSES for thresholds.
defaults.limitations: Obfuscated clients rename classes; this list only helps with readable class names.

rules.name: Cheat module class: KillAura
rules.description: A class named KillAura (optionally suffixed Module/Hack/Feature) is a cheat feature that legitimate mods do not implement as a class.
